paragraphes: The investment objective is to achieve a performance net of management fees that exceeds that of the following simple benchmark over the recommended investment period of 5 years: MSCI Nordic 10/40 Index. The benchmark index is expressed in EUR.
note: Section reprise : Investment Policy (seul texte descriptif de la factsheet). Factsheet française disponible seulement en 04-2025 (périmée), donc version anglaise 08-2026 retenue.
